user.title: Add a room
user.description: Net heat flow into or out of a room from the AC power and the room temperature. The room's heat capacity is learned automatically from AC power steps. Efficiency (COP) and calibration settings are under Configure afterwards.

data_description.temperature_sensor: A sensor you trust, away from the AC's air flow.
data_description.power_sensor: W or kW. Electrical input power of the whole unit (preferred) or thermal output.
data_description.power_type: Electrical input is multiplied by the COP. Thermal output must be signed (positive heating, negative cooling) unless a climate entity is given.
data_description.climate_entity: Tells heating from cooling (hvac_action, else the hvac mode). Required for electrical power.
data_description.compressor_sensor: Optional. While off, the AC adds no heat (standby and fan power are ignored).
data_description.coil_temperature_sensor: Optional. Real condensing/evaporating temperature for the COP model, detects defrost and the direction in auto mode.

error.climate_required: Electrical power has no sign: pick the AC climate entity so heating and cooling can be told apart.
error.outdoor_entity_required: Pick the outdoor temperature entity, or choose another source.

data_description.power_type: Electrical input is multiplied by the COP. Thermal output must be signed unless a climate entity is given.
data_description.outdoor_source: For the COP model. Open-Meteo uses the Home Assistant location and needs no account. Avoid sensors in the sun.
data_description.outdoor_entity: A temperature sensor or a weather entity. Only used with the source "Entity".
data_description.pause_entities: Binary sensors, switches, input booleans or sun.sun (paused while above the horizon). Examples: window open, sun on the window.

efficiency.name: Efficiency (COP)
efficiency.description: Only used for electrical power. The EU energy label gives SCOP (heating) and SEER (cooling); they roughly correspond to 7 °C and 25 °C outdoors. For EN 14511 rated values use 7 °C and 35 °C.

data_description.cop_mode: Model: the value follows indoor, outdoor (and coil) temperature like a heat pump does. Fixed: always the value entered.

calibration.name: Heat capacity calibration
calibration.description: A step event: the AC power changes by at least the minimum step compared to the window before. After the settling time and the measuring time, the energy balance is fitted over the window before and the measuring window. The power may keep modulating.

data_description.calibration_modes: Cooling includes dehumidification (latent heat), which tends to make the heat capacity too small.
data_description.fit_minutes: Keep this short: with longer windows walls and furniture take part and the heat capacity grows.
data_description.max_uncertainty: Events whose heat capacity has a larger standard error are dropped (noisy sensor, too small a step, the sun came out).

data_description.live_minutes: Temperature slope and AC power are averaged over this window. The room sensor's resolution makes shorter windows noisy.
